papers.title: Visible Light Photoinitiation of Cell-Adhesive Gelatin Methacryloyl Hydrogels for Stereolithography 3D Bioprinting.
papers.abstract: We present the first cell-attachable and visible-light-crosslinkable bioinks based on gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) with eosin Y (EY) photoinitiation for stereolithography three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting. To develop a visible-light-crosslinkable hydrogel, we systematically studied five combinations of GelMA and EY photoinitiator with various concentrations. Their mechanical properties, microstructures, and cell viability and confluency after encapsulation were investigated rigorously to elucidate the effects of the EY and GelMA macromer concentrations on the characteristics of the hydrogel. Experimental results show that the compressive Young's modulus and pore size are positively affected by the concentration of EY, whereas the mass swelling ratio and cell viability are negatively affected. Increasing the concentration of GelMA helps in improving the compressive Young's modulus and cell attachment. We further employed the developed visible-light-based stereolithography bioprinting system to print the patterned cell-laden hydrogels to demonstrate the bioprinting applications of the developed hydrogel. We observed good cell proliferation and the formation of a 3D cellular network inside the printed pattern at day 5, which proves the great feasibility of using EY-GelMA as the bioinks for biofabrication and tissue engineering.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文只涉及生物墨水材料，未包含AI技术，因此与研究者的AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate any AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; it focuses solely on bioink material characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可见光交联的细胞粘附生物墨水用于立体光刻生物打印
summary_zh.method: 系统研究不同浓度EY和GelMA的组合，表征力学、微观结构和细胞活性
summary_zh.result: EY浓度增加提高模量和孔径但降低细胞活性，GelMA浓度增加提高模量和细胞附着
summary_zh.validation: 通过打印细胞负载水凝胶并观察三维细胞网络形成验证可行性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a visible-light-crosslinkable and cell-attachable bioink for stereolithography bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Systematically investigated combinations of GelMA and eosin Y photoinitiator with varying concentrations, characterizing mechanical properties, microstructure, cell viability, and confluency.
summary_en.result: Higher EY concentration increased compressive modulus and pore size but decreased cell viability; higher GelMA concentration improved modulus and cell attachment.
summary_en.validation: Validated by printing cell-laden hydrogels and observing cell proliferation and 3D cellular network formation after 5 days.

papers.title: [Progress in biocompatibility and surface modification of nickel titanium shape memory alloys].
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To summarize the research progress of biocompatibility and surface modification of nickel titanium shape memory alloys (Ni-Ti SMA). METHODS: The relative researches about Ni-Ti SMA at home and abroad were reviewed, collated, analyzed, and summarized. RESULTS: At present, Ni-Ti SMA as an internal fixation material has been widely used in clinic. It has the following advantages: the super elasticity, the shape memory characteristic, the good wear resistance, and the strong corrosion resistance. It also can effectively avoid the internal fixator rupture caused by stress shielding. After surface modification, the biocompatibility of Ni-Ti SMA has been improved. CONCLUSION: The Ni-Ti SMA is the most promising alloy material for the long-term internal fixator because of its excellent material properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文献综述了镍钛形状记忆合金的生物相容性和表面改性，但与髋关节假体的应力遮挡量化、微动分析或有限元建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or provide boundary conditions for finite element analysis of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述镍钛形状记忆合金的生物相容性和表面改性研究进展。
summary_zh.method: 通过文献回顾、整理和分析对NiTi SMA的研究进行总结。
summary_zh.result: NiTi SMA具有良好的超弹性、形状记忆、耐磨和耐腐蚀性能，表面改性可提升生物相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，纯文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To summarize the research progress on biocompatibility and surface modification of nickel titanium shape memory alloys (NiTi SMA).
summary_en.method: A literature review was conducted to collate and analyze domestic and international studies on NiTi SMA.
summary_en.result: NiTi SMA exhibits excellent superelasticity, shape memory, wear resistance, and corrosion resistance, and surface modification improves its biocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation was performed; the study is a narrative review.
